system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions

More of a convenience than a necessity for wilderness scouts, the Subsonic Field Emitter generates a subsonic pulse attuned to the nervous systems of nonsentient insects and other vermin, discouraging them from entering the emitter's 6-meter broadcast radius and allowing beings within the radius to relax without being disturbed by natural pests. Tiny or smaller creatures with an Intelligence score of 2 or less cannot willfully enter the radius of a Subsonic Field Emitter.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
